item.description:
Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Automatically install updates. A new switch in Settings › Updates. New versions download in the background and install the next time you quit. Normal Mail never quits or restarts on its own.
  • Know when an update is ready. Once an update has downloaded, a notification says so, with a Restart Now button. The Normal Mail menu and Settings › Updates offer Restart Now too. If you never quit, you get a reminder once a day.

Improvements

  • You now get a notification when a new version is out, even if Normal Mail is in the background. Before, the update window waited until you next switched to the app.
  • Normal Mail checks for updates every hour instead of once a day, and no longer asks whether to check automatically.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Reply from the notch, with Undo. After you send a reply from the notch, it shows "Sending…" for a few seconds with an Undo button, then "Sent". If it can't send, your reply stays in the field so you can try again.
  • Keyboard shortcuts in the sidebar. ⌘2 opens Starred and ⌘3 opens Needs Reply, next to ⌘1 for the Inbox. Hold ⌘ for a moment to see them in the sidebar.
  • All Inboxes, All Starred and Needs Reply now sit under their own "All Accounts" heading.

Improvements

  • Every row in the sidebar now has the same layout, so icons and names line up, including the Tools group.
  • Large unread counts are shortened (42.9K) so they no longer squeeze mailbox names.
  • The sidebar can't be made so narrow that names get cut off.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Clicking the menu bar icon, or switching back to Normal Mail, checks for new mail right away.
  • Tooltips on rows now appear under the pointer instead of covering the row above.

Bug fixes

  • Moving the Tools group by dragging could save the new place but leave the sidebar showing the old order.
  • Needs Reply could miss questions from more than a page back in a busy Inbox, and could count your own replies sent from an alias.
  • "Remind me if no reply" is now kept when you close a draft and open it again.
  • An automatic reply from a no-reply or notification address no longer cancels a "Remind me if no reply" reminder.
  • Dragging mail or a mailbox onto another account's mailbox is now refused instead of seeming to work and doing nothing.
  • A search started from ⌘K no longer keeps filters left over from an earlier search.
